name: Vox Hairdressing
lead: A boutique salon in the heart of the Northern Quarter since 2013, specialising in precision cutting, bespoke colour and low-maintenance balayage. Kevin Murphy colour and styling, sulphate-free and cruelty-free.

experience.title: Rebuilt with intention
experience.text: Our salon was stripped back and rebuilt, from lighting and layout to bespoke handmade workstations and refreshment areas, to feel calm, welcoming and quietly luxurious. Every appointment begins with a detailed consultation.

currency_note: A genderless menu, priced by length, time and complexity. Senior stylist / graduate stylist. Cuts include wash & blow dry.

special.title: 10% off your first visit
special.text: New clients get 10% off. Tell us about your hair, your routine and what you want to achieve, and we'll design something that works with your lifestyle.

reviews: I had my haircut with Phoenix today, and it was such a great experience. I'm so happy with the result!  She was incredibly friendly and professional.
Such a good experience! I’ve been on the hunt for a new hairdresser after relocating to Manchester and I’m so glad I went with Vox. I even got 10% off for being a new customer.
Had a great experience with Phoenix who gave me some good advice and product recommendations for wearing my hair curly! It's hard to find stylists who get curly hair. Thank you!.

After years of trying to find a proper good hairdressers, that not only does great hair but makes you feel good too, I think I’ve finally found it! ✨  Vox is such a nice salon, great interior, great vibe, and Senior Stylist, Nuala, who did my hair was a dream; she listened to exactly what I had in mind, told me what she thought would work best with my hair type and then gave me the best cut I’ve had in ages. I will absolutely be returning!.
